@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/src.message: Import from the package root instead. Everything supported is re-exported from `@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk` (or `/testing` for the harness); `src/` is internal layout and moves without a major bump.

@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/dist.message: Import from the package root instead. `dist/` is build output, not API: its file layout is a bundler detail and will change.

@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/src/__generated__.message: Import the contract types from the package root. The generated module is regenerated from Sitrep.Contract on every mod build and its path is not stable.
